about.title: Truckee Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Truckee's mountain roads carry heavy seasonal traffic, and Nevada County's public crash records show that even a small town sees real consequences on corridors like I-80, Donner Pass Road, and Route 267. When a crash turns fatal, the grief is immediate, but California law also puts a clock on your legal options. Surviving spouses, domestic partners, and children have priority standing to bring a wrongful death claim, with certain dependents and heirs eligible in other circumstances. LawProactive is not a law firm — we're a free service that connects grieving families in Truckee with an independent personal injury attorney who can explain what a claim might recover, from funeral and burial costs to lost financial support and the loss of a loved one's companionship and guidance. You don't have to sort through this alone or figure out the legal side while you're still grieving. A short, no-obligation conversation with an attorney in our network can help you understand where things stand and what timeline applies to your situation.

whyChoose.title: What Truckee Families Should Know About Wrongful Death Claims

items.title: Only Certain Family Members Can File
items.desc: California law gives standing first to a surviving spouse, domestic partner, or children, with other dependents or heirs eligible in some cases. An attorney can help identify who in your family qualifies to bring the claim.

items.title: A Strict Two-Year Deadline Applies
items.desc: Most wrongful death claims in California must be filed within two years of the date of death, though claims involving a government entity — such as a public roadway defect — carry a much shorter deadline. Acting sooner preserves evidence and options.

items.title: The Civil Claim Stands Apart from Any Criminal Case
items.desc: A wrongful death lawsuit is separate from any criminal charges tied to the crash and follows its own timeline and standard of proof. Families can pursue a civil claim for losses like lost support and companionship regardless of what happens in a criminal court.

items.question: Who is allowed to file a wrongful death claim in Truckee?
items.answer: California law prioritizes a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children first. If none exist, other dependents or heirs may have standing depending on the circumstances. An independent attorney can review your family situation and explain who qualifies.

items.question: How long do we have to file after a fatal crash on a road like I-80 or Donner Pass Road?
items.answer: Generally, California gives families two years from the date of death to file a wrongful death claim. If the crash involved a government entity, such as a claim tied to road design or maintenance on a state route, the deadline to act is much shorter. It's worth having an attorney check the specifics of your case early.

items.question: What kinds of losses can a wrongful death claim cover?
items.answer: A claim may address funeral and burial costs, the financial support your loved one would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. It does not put a price on grief itself, but it can help ease the financial burden that follows a sudden loss. An attorney in our network can walk you through what applies to your family's situation.
